const std = @import("std");

/// An open encoder.
pub const Ctx = opaque {};

const Scratch = opaque {};

/// Create one.
pub export fn zc_new() ?*Ctx {
    return null;
}

export fn zc_free(ctx: *Ctx) void {
    _ = ctx;
}

fn helper(x: i32) i32 {
    return x;
}

export fn zc_peek(
    ctx: ?*const Ctx,
) i32 {
    _ = ctx;
    return 0;
}
